ceremony.name: Identity vetting
ceremony.choreography: docs/25-ceremony-scenarios.md section 6.6: request, session answered with a signed Vetting Card bound to the session (up to 3 rounds), then a Vetting Statement citing the session or a decline. The reference party models only what the scenario observes, never a community's vetter policy.

scenarios.title: request, session, the applicant's signed card bound to the session, then the vetter's statement citing that session: both read completed, the applicant holds the statement

source.note: Ceremony scenario step (docs/25): the task is a Trust Tasks specification (tfRef, status draft); the choreography around it is a suite proposal and advisory. The result of running it is evidence of kind complete-ceremony, never a conformance count.
